title: Complete Resolution Of A Family Of Twisted Thue Equations
summary: One of the first infinite families of Thue equations, $$F_n(X)=X^3 - (n-1) X^2Y - (n+2)XY^2 - Y^3 = \pm 1$$ for $n\in \mathbb{Z}$, was solved by Thomas in 1990. This family is associated to the simplest cubic fields $\mathbb{Q}(λ)$ of Shanks, where $λ$ is a root of $F_n(X,1)$. Levesque and Waldschmidt twisted the Thue equations by an exponent $t$ and looked at the equation $$N_{\mathbb{Q}(λ)/\mathbb{Q}}(X-λ^t Y)=\pm 1,$$ where $t\in \mathbb{Z}$ with $t\neq 0$.
